packageRules.description: Stay at R74: commit dec22cec (2026-04-16, 'Print warning when API3 plugins are loaded') adds an mtWarning for every API3 plugin; first tag containing it is R75RC1, so R74 is the last silent release

Cap at R79: commit 819672d3 (2026-08-13, 'Remove API3 support') replaces the API3 loader with a hard VSException and is already an ancestor of tag R80A1, so R79 is the last release that can load API3 plugins
